messages:
emily: Hey team, day 1 here. Two tiny asks: 1) who handles laptop provisioning + badge pickup? 2) who owns service/team runbooks & oncall lists? I'm blocked on a repo invite and need VPN too.

rajesh: welcome Emily! :tada: Laptop + badge -> IT handles both. File the hardware request: https://internal.redwood/it/hardware (choose "new hire laptop"). Badge pickups are M-F 9-5 at HQ reception (bring ID). For repo invites we need your GitHub handle pasted in the ticket.

it-bot: Hardware ticket created: #HW-3421 (EMILY) ETA 2 business days for laptop imaging. If you picked "expedite" we'll try same-day. Track status here: https://internal.redwood/it/tickets/HW-3421

claire: hi Emily — for ownership:
- infra & infra repos: @tony (platform) + backup @sam
- runtime/model-serving: eng-runtime team -> see runbook link below
- docs & onboarding repos: people-ops/docs (owner: rajesh)
Oncall lists are in PagerDuty and the runbook. If you need the quick list: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/owners-quickview

oncall-bot: PagerDuty: eng-oncall rotation this week: primary -> @nina, secondary -> @jeff. SEV1: page eng-oncall PD and DM service owner. SEV2: open an incident thread in #incidents and assign owner. See https://pagerduty.com/redwood/eng-oncall

tony: adding how we prefer escalations (short):
1) SEV1: page PD + DM owner + post short note in #incidents (subject: SEV1 - service-name)
2) SEV2: create incident thread in #incidents, assign owner, tag "SEV2"
3) Access / account issues: open infra ticket or ping #eng-infra (prefix "access:")
Runbooks + owners: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/service-ownership (owner emails + backups listed). If you can't reach owner, page eng-oncall.

emily: thanks, that helps. For the repo invite: my handle is emilyb. Also, small question: can I get temporary sudo on the laptop to install some dev pkgs?

rajesh: we ship laptops with admin disabled by default. For temp admin, open an IT ticket and request "temporary admin for dev" with justification and duration. Usually approved for 4 hours same-day.

claire: also join #new-hires-week1 and I'll set up a quick sync to run through team boundaries and who to ping for different flows. Welcome again!

emily: joining both now. Appreciate the fast help everyone :smile: will upload my ID to the hardware ticket and ping if VPN still fails.
